**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 already sits at our preferred position on every audit parameter:

- **Frequency** — no more than once in any twelve-month period (22.1)
- **Notice** — at least thirty days' prior written notice (22.1)
- **Manner** — normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1)
- **Cost** — Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2)
- **System access** — expressly prohibited: Vendor and its auditor "may not access Customer systems directly," nor unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information (22.2)

Section 22.3 layers on further customer-side protection (findings are our Confidential Information, enforcement-only use, copy of the final report, and finality once a shortfall is paid).

I also confirmed no broader audit right hides elsewhere: Section 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains only a heading with no operative text, and a document-wide search for audit/inspect/verify/records language surfaced nothing else binding us.
